squad.requestsHint: Other NoCap servers that asked to link with this one, and requests this server sent. Requests expire after 10 minutes.
squad.compare: Before accepting, check that these fingerprints match the ones shown on {name}.
squad.linkedHint: NoCap servers linked with this one. Each keeps its own accounts; sharing between linked servers will come in a later update.
squad.linkedEmpty: No linked servers yet. Find a server above and send it a link request.
squad.unlinkMsg: {name} will be removed from linked servers on both servers. You can send a new link request later.
squad.phonesHint: Phones with the NoCap OS app that asked to link without a code. Accept only if the digits match the ones on the phone.
squad.phoneForOther: Asks to link to {user}'s account; only {user} can accept it
squad.phoneUnknown: Asks for {user}, but there is no account with that name. It can only be declined.
